title: Payment authorisations rejected in bursts
root_cause_summary: A retry storm from an earlier blip pushed call volume past the payment provider's 600/min quota, so the provider returned 429 for the excess.

required_evidence.why: the provider rejecting on quota, with the quota named
the calls_per_min series at onset, our call volume doubling, which is what crossed the quota
the retry change that turned a blip into a storm

red_herrings.why_tempting: reads as a checkout regression rather than an upstream rejecting our excess volume
